The '''Broken Spine''' was a criminal cartel that was long-forgotten by the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. They used the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Attahox/Legends|Attahox]] as a hideout.<ref name="Filthy Business">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Filthy Business}}</ref>
